_doc: Baseline used by .github/workflows/upstream-check.yml. The pinned_commit is the typescript-eslint upstream commit that the vendored fixtures in testdata/typescript-eslint/ correspond to. file_hashes is SHA-256 of each fixture file content; per_rule_pass_counts is the harness pass/total at that pin. The first upstream-check run will detect 'no baseline' and the issue it opens will include a PR-ready baseline to commit.
